ov: The largest land-dwelling member of the weasel family, a solitary, muscular carnivore of the far north. It has a reputation for ferocity and strength out of all proportion to its size. Males can weigh 30–40% more than females.

why.dg: It has a reputation for ferocity and strength out of all proportion to its size.

rg: Northern forests and tundra of the Northern Hemisphere: Canada, Alaska, the Nordic countries, Russia and Siberia.
df: Mainly a scavenger, but it can kill prey many times its size and tear meat from carcasses frozen solid.
fx: Its pungent scent glands earned it the nicknames “skunk bear” and “nasty cat”.
Only the sea otter, giant otter and African clawless otter are bigger members of its family.
